summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting two linked events: (1) termination of its arrangement agreement with Zijin Gold, as closing conditions were unlikely to be met by the July 29, 2026 outside date due to cross-border regulatory factors; (2) a concurrent US$295 million strategic investment by Zijin Gold at C$32.55/share (30-day VWAP), representing a premium to market. Post-closing, Zijin will hold ~9.2% of Allied shares. No break fee or advisor is named. The subscription is non-brokered private placement subject to TSX/NYSE approval, expected to close on or about August 10, 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance and the impact of the new 9.2% stake on future M&A optionality.
